title: 第25章 前路已通第26章 穿越都市小说
slug: 我都无敌了要你这系统有何用
content_zh:
“宿主，你反正也看不上秘境中的东西，不如……”
“也行，反正也不是什么好货，用来结账了！”
“可以！
可以！
可以！”
青墨感觉到了系统的兴奋！
“我有欠那么多吗？”
（ー_ー）!!
“你说呢？”
（???）
秘境中的妖兽感觉到了大白的气息，纷纷躲了起来，青墨等人就在秘境中闲逛了起来，遇到的那些灵药和灵宝青墨和柳雨柔看都不看一眼，倒是寒千雪看得眼睛都直了，见青墨看到这些灵药就像空气一样。
寒千雪倒是很努力的收集天材地宝，毕竟这种情况以前想都不敢想！
青墨搂着柳雨柔的细腰，享受着从手心传来的触感，大白亦步亦趋的跟在后面，它达到天穹境后也看不上这些东西了，自己主人手指缝随便露出来一点点都比这里的好不知道多少倍！
“千雪，这些灵药年份太低，灵宝也没什么用，你用得着拿吗？”
青墨让寒千雪回到自己身边，看到寒千雪眼里只有灵药灵宝，搂着细腰的手向上浮动到胸前捏了捏，让寒千雪浑身一颤！
“主人，这些都还低级吗？有很多都是超过十万年以上的大药！
灵宝也是外面很罕见的材料呢！”
寒千雪的大眼睛一眨一眨的看向青墨，毕竟她跟着青墨这段时间里，青墨也没露出过什么好东西让她知道，她印象中就只认为青墨的修为和炼丹术都举世无双而已！
“千雪姑娘，主人刚刚要我来当坐骑的时候直接给了我五百万年份的大药，主人还说那是他拥有年份药效最低的了！”
“五，五百万年份的大药！

！”
大白的声音从身后传来，寒千雪听到后脑子像被雷劈了一样，整个人站在原地不知所措，她从来没想过自己的主人居然那么有料！
跟着青墨一起进秘境的势力们就没那么好过了，因为大白一直散发着天穹境的气势，搞得秘境中的妖兽把怒火都发泄在了那些势力身上。
“这里才是白殇秘境的中心，那个残魂就藏在这里！”
青墨得到拿到冰玉石后来到了一处破旧洞府，之前在路上发现那些天材地宝的价值远远没有洞府里的高，他打算把洞府的东西全部拿来结账！
青墨等人刚进入洞府没多久就发现很多比外面还珍贵的天材地宝，全被青墨收了。
大白和寒千雪倒是觉得浑身不自在！
不过也难怪，里面的残魂生前可是中千世界中最顶尖的那批人，洞府之中也刻画了能刺激人贪欲的阵法，只要一直往里走，一直收取散落的东西，到最深处时心神就会混乱，那时便更大程度增加残魂夺舍成功的几率！
这些小把戏根本瞒不过青墨和柳雨柔的眼睛，至于大白和寒千雪开始就被柳雨柔的能量包裹，根本没察觉到阵法！
青墨把东西收得差不多的时候，看向最深处的平台，平台旁边几块石板上还刻有一些残缺功法，就是诱惑人站上平台感悟功法然后便激活最中心困阵，让进入洞府的人都困死在里面，残魂就能尽情的挑选合适的肉身了！
“走吧！
里面没什么东西了！”
残魂本来还期待青墨继续进入最深处，听到青墨这样说整个人都傻了：“怎么回事？难不成他已经知道这是个陷阱？不对啊！
按照惯例不是应该继续往里走吗？他不可能没被阵法影响啊！”
就在残魂疑惑的时候，青墨真就转身离开，残魂看到青墨等人越走越远的时候终于憋不住了，一道残魂以极快的速度扑向青墨！
“拿了本尊的东西就想走，小子哪有那么便宜的事！
把你的肉身交出来吧！”
“啊！
！”
content_en:
"Host, you don't like the things in the secret realm anyway, why not..."
"Okay, it's not a good product anyway, just use it to pay the bill!"
"Okay!
Yes!
Yes! "
Qing Mo felt the excitement of the system!
"Do I owe that much?"
(ー_ー)!!
"What do you think?"
(???)
The monsters in the secret realm felt Dabai's aura and hid one after another. Qing Mo and others wandered around in the secret realm. Qing Mo and Liu Yurou didn't even look at the elixirs and spiritual treasures they encountered. However, Han Qianxue's eyes widened when she saw Qing Mo seeing these elixirs as if they were air.
Han Qianxue worked very hard to collect heavenly materials and earthly treasures. After all, this kind of situation had never been thought of before!
Qing Mo hugged Liu Yurou's slender waist, enjoying the touch from the palm of his hand. Dabai followed step by step. After it reached the Sky Vault Realm, it no longer looked down on these things. The slightest bit of its master's fingertips exposed was countless times better than the one here!
"Qianxue, these elixirs are too old and the spiritual treasures are useless. Do you need to take them?"
Qing Mo asked Han Qianxue to return to him. When he saw that Han Qianxue only had elixirs and treasures in his eyes, the hand around his thin waist floated up to his chest and squeezed, making Han Qianxue tremble all over!
"Master, are these still low-level? Many of them are great medicines that are more than 100,000 years old!
Lingbao is also a very rare material outside! "
Han Qianxue's big eyes blinked at Qing Mo. After all, during the time she followed Qing Mo, Qing Mo didn't reveal anything good to her. In her impression, she only thought that Qing Mo's cultivation and alchemy skills were unparalleled in the world!
"Miss Qianxue, the master just gave me a five-million-year-old medicine when he asked me to be his mount. The master also said that it was the least effective medicine he had ever owned!"
“Five, five million years of great medicine!
! "
Dabai's voice came from behind. Han Qianxue's head felt like it was struck by lightning. She stood there at a loss. She never thought that her master was so unpredictable!
The forces that followed Qing Mo into the secret realm didn't have it so easy, because Dabai had been exuding the aura of the Sky Realm, causing the monsters in the secret realm to vent their anger on those forces.
"This is the center of Bai Shang's secret realm, and the remnant soul is hidden here!"
After Qing Mo got the ice jade, he came to a dilapidated cave. On the way, he found that the value of the treasures of heaven and earth was far less than that in the cave. He planned to use all the things in the cave to settle the bill!
Not long after Qing Mo and others entered the cave, they discovered that many treasures of heaven, materials and earth that were more precious than those outside were all taken away by Qing Mo.
Dabai and Han Qianxue felt uncomfortable!
But it's no wonder that the remnant souls inside were among the top people in the Middle Thousand Worlds during their lifetimes. The cave also has formations that can stimulate people's greed. As long as you keep walking in and collect scattered things, your mind will be confused when you reach the deepest place. At that time, the chance of success in seizing the remnant souls will be greatly increased!
These little tricks couldn't be hidden from the eyes of Qing Mo and Liu Yurou. As for Dabai and Han Qianxue, they were wrapped in Liu Yurou's energy from the beginning and didn't notice the formation at all!
When Qing Mo had almost collected the things, he looked at the deepest platform. There were some incomplete skills engraved on a few stone slabs next to the platform. It was to tempt people to stand on the platform to understand the skills and then activate the central trapping formation, so that everyone who entered the cave would be trapped inside, and the remaining souls could choose a suitable body to their heart's content!
"Let's go!
There's nothing left in it! "
Remnant Soul was originally expecting Qing Mo to continue entering the deepest part, but when he heard Qing Mo say this, he was dumbfounded: "What's going on? Could it be that he already knew this was a trap? That's not right!
As usual, shouldn't we continue walking in? There's no way he wasn't affected by the formation! "
Just when Remnant Soul was confused, Qing Mozhen turned around.After leaving, the remnant soul finally couldn't hold it in anymore when he saw Qing Mo and others walking further and further away. A remnant soul rushed towards Qing Mo at an extremely fast speed!
“You just want to leave after taking my things, how can you do anything so cheap!
Hand over your body! "
"Ah!
! "
